title: fix(plugin-audit): a mention notification reaches a mentioned user only when they may read the comment it previews
body:
Fixes #26453

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:@提及通知现在要过两道读权限:被提及者既要能读这条评论所在的记录,也要能读这条评论本身。读不到评论的人收不到这条通知。
- **为什么改**:通知里带着评论正文的摘要。能读记录不等于能读评论,因为评论对象有自己的对象权限、租户墙和行级范围。铃铛里的这份副本不能送到评论区本身不给看的人手里。这是安全类卡,细节按维护者裁决不公开。
- **风险与回滚**:如果某个应用给成员的权限集没有授予评论读权限,这些成员以后收不到 @提及通知,这是本修复的预期效果,changeset 里写了管理员该怎么调整。回滚就是 revert 本 PR:只动 `@objectstack/plugin-audit` 一个包,没有数据迁移,也没有 spec 变更。
- **先看**:① `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/mention-recipient-gate.ts` 里逐收件人判定循环新增的评论读取那一行(`readableIn(..., COMMENT_OBJECT, commentId)`);② `mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts` 里新增的 DAVE 用例和 `sys_comment` 读权限替身;③ `.changeset/26453-mention-recipient-reads-comment.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:先构建依赖闭包 `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-audit^...' build`,再跑 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts`,应该看到 15/15 通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`mention-recipient-gate.ts`**: the gate used to decide each mentioned user on one read, the record the comment is on. It now also runs that user's own read of the comment, by id, through `resolveReadableParentIds`, the same evaluator the comment-reaction create door asks of a comment. The read runs in the user's resolved envelope, with their organization claim vetted exactly as before. When that read does not return the comment, the user is withheld and logged with the new reason `cannot_read_thread`. A comment with no id withholds every candidate (`no_comment_id`). The record read stays in place and runs first, for two reasons: the deep link opens the record, and an engine with no middleware seam has no thread read gate to fold the record question into the comment read. The module header is rewritten so that what it claims is true. The old header said a thread is readable exactly when its record is, and that is wrong, because the comment object carries its own grant.
- **`comment-access-hooks.ts`**: `COMMENT_OBJECT` is exported from this internal module so the gate names the object from one source. The package index is unchanged.
- **`audit-writers.ts`, `audit-plugin.ts`**: the doc comments now describe the two-read rule. No code changes in either file.
- **Changeset**: `patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-audit`.

## Tests

`mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts` runs a real kernel, ObjectQL, SQLite, `AuditPlugin` (including its comment read gate) and the real grant resolver.

- **New stand-in**: plugin-security's object-level read grant on `sys_comment`. It is keyed on a position assigned through `sys_user_position`, which the real resolver reads, and it refuses the way the real layer does: a throw carrying `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403. A new fellow member, DAVE, can read the open record but does not hold that position.
- **New pins**:
  - a control: the resolver projects the grant to CAROL and not to DAVE, both read the record, and only CAROL reads the comment, while DAVE's read is refused with `code`/`status`;
  - a recipient who can read the record but not the comment is withheld, by id and by email;
  - only the recipient who can read both is notified, and the author never is;
  - the single posture behaves like a walled one;
  - the withheld-recipient log carries `cannot_read_thread` and `no_comment_id`, and never the comment text.
- **Adjusted pin**: the existing direct-call log pin now reads a real comment id. Before, it passed a non-existent one, which the comment read now correctly refuses.

Ablation: deleting the comment-read limb turns exactly the 5 new gate pins red. The other 10 stay green, including the stand-in control. The file was then restored, and its blob matches HEAD.

<details><summary>One-time check in a real composition (throwaway, not committed)</summary>

- **With the fix**: the gate admitted exactly the recipient who may read both the comment and the record.
- **Mutated leg**: the comment-read limb was deleted and plugin-audit rebuilt. `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` showed the limb absent from `dist/`. The gate admitted the record-only recipient too, and that was the one red assertion. The rebuild exited 1 at its DTS stage after writing the JS bundles the suite consumes, so the `dist/` preflight reading, not the build's exit code, certifies this leg.
- **Restore leg**: the rebuild exited 0, the limb was present in `dist/` again, and the result was green again.

The throwaway file was then deleted, and `git status --porcelain` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Behaviour for deployments**: a mentioned user is notified only when the sets they hold grant read on the comment as well as on the record. The changeset tells administrators how to restore notifications for a population that should take part in record discussions: grant comment read in a set that population holds.
- **Producer sweep**: the mention writer in `audit-writers.ts` is the only producer that copies `sys_comment` text into a notification. `approval.comment` in plugin-approvals notifies an approval request's own participants about approval-action comments. That is a different object with its own audience, and it is not in scope here.
- **Cost**: one extra caller-scoped read per mentioned candidate who passes the record read.
- **Timing**: the comment is read from inside the author's write, in `afterInsert`. The engine binds reads there to the write's own unit of work (the ambient transaction store), so the row is visible. A read that cannot see the row withholds, which is the fail-closed direction. The existing CAROL pins exercise this path end to end.
- **Not run locally**:
  - `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project): it belongs to CI's `Test Core`, and this diff changes no test in that project.
  - Full dogfood: the title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.
  - `packages/cli` integration tier: not touched.
